content.subject: ShipBob funding and reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,
ShipBob raised $200M at a $1B+ valuation. That likely expands reconciliation workload across teams, increasing manual effort, error risk, and reporting delays.
We automate intercompany reconciliation via a unified ledger engine in real time for finance and ops teams and compliance.
Worth a 15-minute call next week?
Zamp
